# Snagify

> Snagify is a property inspection app for Dubai rentals. Landlords, tenants, real estate agents and property managers use it to create check-in and check-out condition reports with room-by-room photos, AI-drafted condition notes and digital signatures from both parties. Reports are built on the evidence criteria the Dubai Rental Dispute Center (RDC) weighs. The RDC does not pre-approve any report format.

## Key facts

- Category: rental condition reports (move-in and move-out inspections, inventory, key handover) for the UAE rental market.
- Not a snagging service: Snagify does not carry out snagging or new-build handover inspections.
- Pricing: check-in reports are free. Individuals pay per check-out with credit packs, from AED 99. Agencies and property managers use Pro plans from AED 299 per month, billed annually.
- Signatures: electronic signatures by both parties, in person or by remote link. UAE Federal Decree-Law No. 46 of 2021 gives electronic signatures the same effect as handwritten ones.
- Integrity: every signed report carries a SHA-256 hash and a QR code linking to its verification page.
- Languages: reports in English and Arabic.
- Company: Snagify is operated by Seize Montaigne Technologies LLC, Sharjah Media City Free Zone (Shams), Sharjah, United Arab Emirates, Business License No. 2647852.01. Founder: Pierre Adam.
